priorityPolicy.highest: Preserve 53 observed Class I calendar dates (~27 reusable themes), major feast/rosary/stations/devotional art and existing five-star user images. No interruption for minor portraits.
priorityPolicy.majorSaints: Within existing 75 slots: Apostles, Evangelists, key saints of universal devotion, prominent founders, selected French spiritual figures, locally important patron figure. Source-link and curate good existing originals before any outside discovery.
priorityPolicy.doctors: Retain all 28 historical Doctor records as inventory, but not 28 mandatory dedicated paintings or a license for obscure Doctor-first gallery research. Prioritize Augustine, Jerome, Gregory, Thomas Aquinas, Ambrose, Teresa, Alphonsus, Francis de Sales and other actual module subjects; lesser-known Doctors remain deferred until higher-impact holes are cleared.
priorityPolicy.selectedPatrons: Eligible only when verified specific existing Calendar/Prayer/Formation route, major internationally recognized patron relevant to actual audience, or documented French Catholic/Mauritius devotional importance; distinguish official patron status from association. No universal country-by-country or 1962-calendar exhaustive portraits.
priorityPolicy.scopeRule: A named person in subject-targets.v2, a 1962 calendar occurrence, or a museum catalogue is NOT sufficient alone to create a mandatory painting target.
priorityPolicy.aesthetic: Only user's 0-5 scores govern suitability; 0–2 universally excluded, >=3 enter review, >=4 valuable; preserve historical selections, use single canonical original reused across modules; user style exclusions govern.
methodology: Reconcile requirements for Calendar/Prayers/Formation and weekly display with existing 75 review slots and 207 target list; avoid duplicate ownership.
Reuse and verify rated 5/5 and 4/5 physical masters, exact iconography, mobile view and license before discovery.
Rank truly missing major saints and explicitly selected patrons; keep 28 Doctors in historical list but defer low-value portrait research.
Maintain biblical narrative selective approach; do not divert resources to missing old Bible Atlas slots just to inflate percentages.
